ev_0014.summary: Supervisor check of FE continuation past E toward C. analyze_line_style returned no segment metrics for either span, so ink_support and gap_fraction are not measured numerically. A local detect_lines pass (ROI 470-530, 160-200) returned a solid run line_01 from (469.94,191.82) to (529.17,170.65), angle 160.33 deg. Its line lies on the FE/E-C direction (FE slope about -0.427, E-C slope about -0.436) and covers the E-C sub-span (x 486 to 519) with no reported gap. This run may partly be the small-circle arc or label contact near E, so it is not conclusive. Visually, FE stops at E and the dashed chord EB/CB starts there. Recommend the Critic confirm visually whether FE reaches C. No new objects were added. Existing bindings are unchanged: E=point_02, C=point_04.

payload.notes: Replaced the F--O--E stroke with one solid named path (F) -- (O) -- (E) -- (C).
